landing.title: A wargame for Move on Sui
landing.description: Move-over is a Web3/Move-based wargame inspired by Ethernaut and overthewire.org, played on the Sui blockchain. Each level is a smart contract that needs to be 'hacked'. The game is 100% open source and all levels are contributions made by other players. Do you have an interesting idea? PRs are welcome.
